provenance.source: PR #1233 fix: incorrect line skipping in renderer flush, merged 2024-11-12
provenance.note: the base carries the same single line count, so the alt-screen half of this defect predates the PR: the reviewed lines rewrite the count without giving the alt screen one of its own, and the later fix is what separates them

keywords: one line count for both screens
count is shared between the two screens
moves the cursor up by the wrong number of lines
inline section is repainted at the wrong row
does not track the alt screen separately
count from the alt screen is used inline
wrong number of lines to move up
stale lines are left on screen

left over from the alt screen
bugs.note: flush stores the frame's line count in the one counter both render modes read; entering the alt screen saves the cursor and leaving it restores that position, so the count left behind by an alt-screen frame is then applied to the inline section and the cursor is moved by the wrong amount
